backend/main.mo: Motoko actor storing contact form submissions in memory and exposing methods to submit and retrieve them.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing build/publish flow validation for GIF updates and listing related files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file mapping frontend paths to short descriptions of each component’s purpose and behavior.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base style definitions with extensive OKLCH theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entrypoint defining metadata and loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/PUBLISHING.md: Runbook outlining asset checks, configuration validation, and commands for building and deploying the site on the IC.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component assembling all site sections and global providers including theme, toasts, and CTAs.
frontend/src/components/About.tsx: About section with team image, feature highlights, business description, and CTA buttons.
frontend/src/components/Certificates.tsx: Certificates section displaying the Udyam certificate with preview, details, and actions to view or download.
frontend/src/components/Contact.tsx: Contact form component with inputs, WhatsApp/phone CTAs, and mapped contact info cards; submits data via a mutation hook and shows toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Floating call and WhatsApp buttons that appear after scrolling 300px, opening phone dialer or WhatsApp chat.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with company info, quick navigation links, contact details, and a credit line using the current year.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with top contact bar, scroll-reactive styling, mobile menu handling, and navigation links that scroll to sections.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section with background imagery, AMC highlight, branding, descriptive text, and buttons for quotes or WhatsApp booking.
frontend/src/components/Products.tsx: Product listing component defining LED bulb products with formatted prices and details for display and WhatsApp inquiries.
frontend/src/components/Services.tsx: Renders service cards with core and additional service listings, plus WhatsApp and scroll-to-contact actions.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Displays a grid of customer testimonials with star ratings inside styled cards.
frontend/src/components/WorkVideo.tsx: Generates a canvas-based animated montage of work photos with play, pause, speed, and recording controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, stored identities, and status management.
frontend/src/hooks/useMontagePlayer.ts: Controls slideshow state with play, pause, restart, and speed adjustments for timed image transitions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exposes React Query hooks for submitting contact forms and retrieving contact submissions through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, color variables, dark mode themes, utility classes, scroll behavior, and animation keyframes.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports static branding info and a generated emergency services tagline.
frontend/src/lib/montageRecorder.ts: Provides browser-based canvas montage recording with transitions and outputs a WebM video.
frontend/src/lib/scroll.ts: Implements smooth scrolling helpers that adjust for a fixed header height.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Generates WhatsApp chat URLs for the business with optional preset messages.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and identity provider, loading global styles.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, plugins, and extended utilities using CSS variables.
project_state.json: Describes the project state, existing features, and pending requests for GIF/video autoplay and build publishing.
